question: A person borrowed Rs. 1760 at 6% per annum and Rs. 2240 at 9% per annum at simple interest for the same period. He had to pay Rs. 1536 in all as interest. Find the time (in years).
solution:
**Given:**

Principal 1 (P₁) = Rs. 1760

Rate 1 (R₁) = 6% per annum

Principal 2 (P₂) = Rs. 2240

Rate 2 (R₂) = 9% per annum

Total Interest = Rs. 1536

**Concept Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T) / 100

**Formula Used:**

SI₁ = P₁ × R₁ × T / 100

SI₂ = P₂ × R₂ × T / 100

Total Interest = SI₁ + SI₂

**Calculation:**

SI₁ = 1760 × 6 × T / 100

⇒ SI₁ = 105.6T

SI₂ = 2240 × 9 × T / 100

⇒ SI₂ = 201.6T

Total Interest = SI₁ + SI₂

⇒ 1536 = 105.6T + 201.6T

⇒ 1536 = 307.2T

⇒ T = 1536 / 307.2

⇒ T = 5

**∴ The time period is 5 years.**
